description: This file contains tensor creation utilities for the PyTorch testing framework, including functions to generate tensors with random values of various types and configurations.

methods.name: _uniform_random_
methods.description: Helper function to fill a tensor with uniformly distributed random values within a specified range, with a workaround for large ranges.

methods.name: make_tensor
methods.description: Creates a tensor with specified shape, dtype, device, and value range, supporting various configurations including noncontiguous memory layout and excluding zero values.
